limits: Only explicit human-positive image-group pairs are scored. Blank CSV cells and the no-species folder are not used as negatives; annotation exhaustiveness is unverified. No precision or false-alarm claim.
The 206 multilabel photos are separate from the publisher's 2,140-photo test split; they are reported separately and pooled, never relabelled as test photos.

Filename-coordinate proximity crosses publisher splits. The distance-filtered stratum is >100 m from train, validation and the other scoring cohort. Scored neighbours are not mutually separated; dates/routes still overlap and independent sites are unverified.
Wilson intervals treat labelled pairs as independent; route proximity and multiple labels in one photo can make these intervals optimistic.

Danish groups are not a New Zealand scene answer key. Only Cytisus scoparius is a labelled pipeline lookalike; no watchlist target is labelled (reported unmeasured). Unlabelled incidental taxa remain unassessed.
The publisher does not supply per-file SHA-256 hashes for original JPEGs/features. The checked-in manifest pins HTTPS-acquired bytes; it is not an independently signed publisher manifest.
Dataset and XP4 release: CC BY 4.0 (Zenodo API records 14013930/13891416); publisher code: MIT. The reused PlantCLEF checkpoint is CC BY-NC 4.0. Images and checkpoints stay outside Git.

XP4 comparison scores the released linear/max/sigmoid head over cached publisher BEiT features (926 views), not end-to-end feature extraction. Released strict cutoffs select a variable number of groups; this is not a five-slot comparison.

configuration.model: released XP4 linear/max/sigmoid head over supplied BEiT features
configuration.aggregation: maximum logit over 926 feature rows then sigmoid
configuration.precision: released CUDA FP16 autocast; CPU fallback FP32
configuration.comparison: released XP4 thresholds from publisher validation only
configuration.split_policy: split_of(source_id); held-out only within publisher test and separate multilabel
configuration.distance_filter: 3D Earth chord from filename coordinates; >100m from train+val+other scoring cohort
configuration.inference_timing_scope: per-photo decode/load plus every reported inference method; excludes model initialization
configuration.calibration_split: publisher validation (2160 photos), no test fitting
configuration.calibration_rule: released xp4_val; maximum Youden J on publisher validation
